notes.text: TWO states adding numbers of any length. Each input symbol is a bit-pair — one bit from each number, least-significant first — and the output stream is their sum. The carry is the only memory addition ever needs. This is the serial adder circuit inside real hardware.
Separate pairs with spaces: 01 11 10 00 adds 6+3 (read bits bottom-up). End with 00 to flush a final carry — exactly what fixed word width does in a CPU.

meta.title: Serial binary adder
meta.blurb: Adds two arbitrarily long binary numbers with just two states: feed bit-pairs LSB-first, read the sum off the output. Carry in the state, nothing else — the circuit in your CPU.
